WEB, FIRST PY: THE ONE ABOLISHED VERB IN THAT ADDON. 155 -> 154.

`web_read.py`'s `_validate_web_save_vals` raises `UserError` when the client posts a
field the model no longer has, so §2.4's Validation row applies and `_check_*` is the
canonical: `_check_web_save_vals`. It is the whole of `addons/web`'s ratchet-visible
naming debt -- `naming_vocabulary.py --roots addons/web` now reports 0 -- and the
smaller half of what the addon owed. The other twenty renames in this change open with
a token `classify` already scores as canonical or as carrying no rule at all, which is
the blind spot §2.4 records for `ir_actions.py` and `ir_asset_paths.py` and which this
addon reproduces: six verbless `_search_panel_*` names, three verbless
`_web_read_group_*` names, a `_resolve_` on a producer that cannot decline, a `_set_`
the mutation row abolishes, and a participle standing in for its own verb.

Measured in a detached worktree at HEAD (`c16a8b162c7`) with this change's files copied
in, because the shared tree carries three other sessions' uncommitted work and one of
their commits landed mid-measurement:

  HEAD alone       155   (reproduces the committed floor)
